metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_load_bytes
metrics.documentation: Total bytes loaded from offload storage to GPU.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_load_time
metrics.documentation: Total load time from offload storage to GPU, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_load_size
metrics.documentation: Histogram of KV offload load operation size, in bytes.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_store_bytes
metrics.documentation: Total bytes stored from GPU to offload storage.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_store_time
metrics.documentation: Total store time from GPU to offload storage, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_store_size
metrics.documentation: Histogram of KV offload store operation size, in bytes.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_lookup_sync_delay_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time spent in a single offload lookup call, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_lookup_async_delay_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of deferred offload lookup resolve latency, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_allocation_failure
metrics.documentation: Number of KV offload store allocation attempts that failed.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space currently pinned by active transfers.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_write_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space pinned by in-flight stores.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_read_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space pinned by in-flight loads.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_allocation_size
metrics.documentation: Histogram of CPU chunks requested by each prepare_store call.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_stores_skipped
metrics.documentation: Number of KV offload stores skipped due to reuse threshold.
